title: Accounts & Business Advisory Associate
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company

Hays are delighted to be partnering with a highly respected and forward-thinking accountancy firm in Suffolk to recruit an Accounts & Business Advisory Associate for their Saxmundham office.
This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative and supportive team that works with a diverse portfolio of owner-managed businesses, SMEs and private clients across the region. The firm is renowned for investing in its people, providing excellent career development opportunities, professional study support and exposure to a broad range of accounting, tax and advisory work.
With a strong focus on client relationships, technical excellence and career progression, this is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious accountancy practice professional looking to continue developing their skills and build a long-term career within a leading regional firm.

Your new role
As an Accounts & Business Advisory Associate, you will play a key role in supporting a diverse portfolio of clients, helping to deliver high-quality accounting, compliance and advisory services. Working closely with senior team members, you will gain exposure to a broad range of accounting and tax matters while continuing to develop your technical expertise within a collaborative and supportive environment.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Preparing statutory accounts for a varied client base
- Assisting with bookkeeping, VAT returns and management accounts
- Supporting the preparation of corporation tax computations
- Performing account reconciliations and resolving discrepancies
- Liaising directly with clients to obtain information and respond to queries
- Working with cloud-based accounting software, including Xero and other digital tools
- Assisting with payroll reconciliations and compliance work
- Supporting senior colleagues with advisory and compliance assignments
- Ensuring work is completed accurately and within agreed deadlines
- Building and maintaining strong client relationships through excellent service delivery

What you'll need to succeed
To be successful in this role, you'll be studying towards a relevant accountancy qualification (AAT, ACA, ACCA or equivalent) or be qualified by experience, with previous accountancy practice experience and a strong technical foundation.
You will ideally have experience in:
- Preparing VAT returns and VAT reconciliations
- Working with a variety of VAT schemes, including Cash Accounting, Flat Rate and Partial Exemption
- Reconciling payroll control accounts, wages and turnover figures
- Assisting with bookkeeping and accounts preparation assignments
- Preparing and reviewing client records using cloud accounting software, including Xero
- Managing bank feeds and bank rules within accounting systems
- Understanding the distinction between accounting profit and taxable profit
- Supporting personal tax compliance work, including awareness of income tax bands and available allowances
- Assisting with P11 D information gathering and submissions
- Communicating directly with HMRC and clients in a professional manner
- Identifying unusual or high-risk items and escalating where appropriate

You'll be highly organised, possess excellent attention to detail and be comfortable managing multiple client deadlines, whilst delivering an outstanding level of service and building strong client relationships.

What you'll get in return

You would be joining a highly regarded and people-focused accountancy practice that is committed to supporting your professional and personal development.
You'll benefit from:
- Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package
- Full ACA/ACCA study support
- Clear career progression opportunities within a growing firm
- Exposure to a varied portfolio of SME, owner-managed business and private clients
- Ongoing training and development from experienced professionals
- A collaborative and supportive team environment
- Modern systems and cloud-based accounting technology
- The opportunity to broaden your accounts, tax and advisory experience
- Long-term career prospects within a respected regional practice

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious accountancy practice professional looking to build a successful career within a firm that genuinely invests in its people and provides a clear pathway for progression.

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays EA is a trading division of Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited and acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Are you looking to build a successful career in finance? We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented, and proactive Finance Assistant to support a busy finance function. This role is ideal for someone with strong numerical skills, excellent attention to detail, and a desire to develop their accounting and finance knowledge within a supportive environment.

As a Finance Assistant, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, processing transactions, and supporting reporting and reconciliation activities. You will work closely with colleagues, customers, and suppliers to ensure the smooth running of day-to-day finance operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices accurately and within agreed timescales.
- Assist with bank reconciliations, ensuring all transactions are recorded correctly.
- Maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable records, keeping financial information accurate and up to date.
- Respond to account queries from customers and suppliers in a professional and timely manner.
- Chase outstanding payments via telephone, email, and written correspondence to support effective credit control.
- Liaise with creditors and assist in the preparation and maintenance of purchase reporting.
- Provide administrative support to the finance team, including filing, data entry, and maintaining financial records and databases.
- Support month-end processes and other finance-related tasks as required.

Skills & Qualifications
- Previous experience in a finance, accounts, or accounting role is desirable but not essential.
- Proficient in accounting software
- Strong numerical ability with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with customers, suppliers, and colleagues.
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn and develop within a finance career.

title: Accounts Assistant - 6 Month Contract
description:
Accounts & Payroll Support Coordinator

Location: Suffolk
Contract: Temporary or Fixed-Term Contract (Minimum 6 Months)
Reporting to: Office Manager
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

The Opportunity

An established and growing organisation is seeking an experienced Accounts & Payroll Support professional to provide additional resilience and operational support within a busy Finance function.

This is a hands-on role focused primarily on payroll, whilst also supporting invoicing and wider transactional accounting activities. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of core finance operations during a period of increased workload and team absence.

This position is not a management role. Instead, it is an opportunity for a capable finance professional to provide practical support, help maintain continuity and identify opportunities to improve existing processes.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll
- Support the processing of weekly and monthly payrolls.
- Ensure payroll data is accurate and processed within required deadlines.
- Assist with payroll administration and employee payroll queries.
- Support payroll reconciliations and reporting requirements.
- Help maintain compliance with payroll procedures and controls.

Accounts Support
- Assist with invoicing and billing processes.
- Support sales ledger and purchase ledger activities.
- Process financial transactions accurately and efficiently.
- Assist with reconciliations and investigation of discrepancies.
- Support the wider finance team with day-to-day accounting duties.

Process Improvement
- Review existing finance and payroll procedures.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and streamline processes.
- Make recommendations to reduce reliance on manual tasks and legacy ways of working.
- Support the implementation of operational improvements where appropriate.

Person Specification

Essential
- Previous experience in a payroll and/or accounts position.
- Strong payroll processing experience.
- Good understanding of transactional accounting processes.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Proactive and hands-on approach to work.

Desirable
- Experience working across both payroll and finance functions.
- Experience supporting high-volume payroll operations.
- Knowledge of invoicing, sales ledger and purchase ledger processes.
- Experience identifying and implementing process improvements.
- Previous experience within a service-led or care-related organisation.

Personal Attributes
- Collaborative and supportive team player.
- Confident working independently when required.
- Adaptable and able to integrate quickly into an established team.
- Strong problem-solving skills.
- Professional and approachable communication style.

What's on Offer?
- Immediate start available.
- Minimum six-month assignment providing stability and continuity.
- Opportunity to make a genuine impact within a busy finance function.
- Varied role combining payroll, accounts support and process improvement activities.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.

This role would suit an experienced Accounts or Payroll professional who enjoys being operationally involved, supporting business-critical processes and helping organisations navigate periods of change and growth.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Mid Suffolk, between Bury St Edmunds and Stowmarket

If you like being the person who keeps cash moving and customers happy at the same time, this one's worth a look.

You'll join a busy billing and credit control team, raising sales invoices and credit notes, checking quotation details meet audit standards before anything goes out, and keeping the ledger accurate. The heart of the role is collections: progressing payments due, chasing overdue accounts by email, letter and phone in line with credit and collection procedures, and processing bank receipts and allocating payments. When a customer or the sales team has a query on an invoice, you'll be the one who picks it up quickly and gets it sorted.

You'll need experience of a high-volume, high-value invoicing environment, alongside time spent in customer service. Excellent communication and a sharp eye for detail matter more than anything else here. Previous credit control or sales ledger experience, good Microsoft Office skills, or time on D365 or a similar finance system will all help.

This role is live and will move quickly, so please get in touch now. For more information, please contact Richard Newcombe at Oakhill Recruitment.
